item.title: His Highness the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani arrived in Berlin on Thursday evening on a state visit to the Federal Republic of Ger…
item.description:
His Highness the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani arrived in Berlin on Thursday evening on a state visit to the Federal Republic of Germany, greeted by a 21-gun salute and accompanied by HE Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani, Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs, and an official delegation. The Amir had left Bern at the end of his state visit to Switzerland, seen off at Bern Airport by Swiss President Guy Parmelin, and sent him a cable of thanks for the warm welcome. The German visit continues on 20 and 21 November.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/19/11/2026/amir-arrives-in-germany-1 · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265452/latest-news/amir-departs-switzerland-for-germany · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/19/11/2026/amir-attends-working-breakfast-with-swiss-president-business-leaders

item.title: Qatar and Pakistan signed in Islamabad a memorandum of understanding on security cooperation between the Internal Security Force (Lekhwiya)…
item.description:
Qatar and Pakistan signed in Islamabad a memorandum of understanding on security cooperation between the Internal Security Force (Lekhwiya) and Pakistan's Federal Constabulary, and an action plan to fight drugs, in the presence of Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif. They were signed by HE Sheikh Khalifa bin Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani, Minister of Interior and Commander of Lekhwiya, and his Pakistani counterpart Mohsin Raza Naqvi, alongside a security cooperation agreement between the two interior ministries. Shehbaz Sharif thanked Qatar for its continued supply of liquefied natural gas, noting that about 300,000 Pakistanis work in Qatar, on the Qatari interior minister's first visit to Pakistan.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/19/11/2026/minister-of-interior-meets-pakistans-prime-minister-in-islamabad · Dawn https://www.dawn.com/news/2045683/pakistan-qatar-sign-mou-on-security-cooperation · The Nation https://www.nation.com.pk/19-Nov-2026/pakistan-qatar-sign-security-cooperation-mou-anti-drug-action-plan · Geo News https://www.geo.tv/latest/691779-pm-shehbaz-thanks-qatar-for-continued-lng-supply-support-to-pakistan

item.title: Qatar condemned in the strongest terms the continued Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, which targeted civilian and economic facilities and in…
item.description:
Qatar condemned in the strongest terms the continued Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, which targeted civilian and economic facilities and infrastructure in Riyadh and caused material damage to the King Abdullah Financial District. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs called them a disgraceful act of aggression and a blatant violation of the Kingdom's sovereignty and of international law, and demanded an immediate halt. It affirmed Qatar's full solidarity with the Kingdom and said its security is an integral part of Qatar's own security and of the GCC collective security system. Kuwait and GCC Secretary-General Jasem Albudaiwi issued similar condemnations.

item.title: The new Traffic Law No. 19 of 2026 takes effect on 19 December, the Ministry of Interior announced at a news conference addressed by Major …
item.description:
The new Traffic Law No. 19 of 2026 takes effect on 19 December, the Ministry of Interior announced at a news conference addressed by Major General Abdullah Khalifa Al Muftah, Director of Public Relations, Brigadier Ahmed Abdullah Al Harami, Director of Legal Affairs, and Brigadier Jabr Ali Al Kubaisi, Director General of Traffic. The law requires electric scooters and similar vehicles to be registered with the licensing authority before road use, restricts carrying passengers on them and on motorcycles and bicycles, requires prior written permission for any writing or stickers on a vehicle, and allows a three-year licence for private cars bought from authorised dealers in Qatar. Owners of vehicles registered under the 2007 law get a six-month grace period, and existing licences remain valid until they expire. The Ministry of Interior warned that, under Article 71, Paragraph 2, the new law bans leaving children under 13 in a vehicle without adult supervision even briefly, a ban that also covers persons with disabilities, the elderly and the sick who need supervision; violators face a QR10,000 fine.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/19/11/2026/new-traffic-law-introduces-regulations-for-electric-scooters · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265030/latest-news/new-traffic-law-enhances-road-safety-keeps-pace-with-advances-in-transportation-interior-ministry · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/19/11/2026/new-traffic-law-prohibits-leaving-children-vulnerable-individuals-without-adult-supervision

item.title: The new edition of the Doha Film Festival opens today, Thursday, and runs to 27 November, screening 104 films from 60 countries, including …
item.description:
The new edition of the Doha Film Festival opens today, Thursday, and runs to 27 November, screening 104 films from 60 countries, including 17 world premieres and 48 Middle East and North Africa premieres, 11 films supported by the Doha Film Institute and seven by women filmmakers. The opening film is The Station, the debut feature of Yemeni-Scottish director Sara Ishaq, set in a women-run petrol station in war-torn Yemen. Competitions include the International Feature, International Short, Made in Qatar and Ajyal strands, alongside the new Cinema Alkhaleej programme, with prizes exceeding $300,000.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/18/11/2026/doha-film-festival-opens-tomorrow-with-sara-ishaqs-the-station · Marhaba Qatar https://marhaba.qa/doha-film-festival-2026-opens-with-sara-ishaqs-the-station/

item.title: Qatar strongly condemned continued Israeli incursions into the countryside of Quneitra and Daraa governorates in southern Syria and repeate…
item.description:
Qatar strongly condemned continued Israeli incursions into the countryside of Quneitra and Daraa governorates in southern Syria and repeated attacks on civilians, including women, children and the elderly. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs called this a flagrant violation of the sovereignty of the Syrian Arab Republic and of international law and a serious threat to regional security, and urged the international community to act urgently to compel Israel to abide by international resolutions, foremost the 1974 disengagement agreement, reaffirming its full support for Syria's sovereignty and territorial integrity.

item.title: Coalition spokesman Brigadier General Turki al-Malki said the initial assessment of the interception of a Houthi missile fired at Riyadh ea…
item.description:
Coalition spokesman Brigadier General Turki al-Malki said the initial assessment of the interception of a Houthi missile fired at Riyadh early Thursday "indicates the impact of debris", while witnesses told AFP the facade of the 80-storey, 385-metre Public Investment Fund Tower, the tallest in King Abdullah Financial District, was damaged with windows blown out across several floors. In a separate statement the coalition said it intercepted and destroyed four Houthi ballistic missiles fired at the Kingdom's southern region, and the US State Department reissued security warnings for Americans in Saudi Arabia and Bahrain. Saudi Civil Defence said the attack caused material damage but no casualties and later reported intercepting more projectiles in the afternoon, while Qatar, Kuwait and the GCC condemned the attack on the King Abdullah Financial District.

item.title: A US official said American jets used precision munitions to strike an IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm Island in self-defence, after Iran…
item.description:
A US official said American jets used precision munitions to strike an IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm Island in self-defence, after Iranian drone attacks on Ali Al-Salem Air Base in Kuwait and sites in Bahrain. CENTCOM photos showed the carriers USS George Washington and USS Theodore Roosevelt in the Arabian Sea, bringing US carriers in the region to three. President Trump said he wants a deal that "can be lasting" and that the conflict will be finished "one way or the other".

item.title: Kuwaiti air defences intercepted hostile drone attacks, the General Staff said, attributing explosions heard in some areas to the intercept…
item.description:
Kuwaiti air defences intercepted hostile drone attacks, the General Staff said, attributing explosions heard in some areas to the interceptions, the first activation since early September, while Bahrain, home of the US Fifth Fleet, said it repelled a new Iranian attack, the fourth in six days. Iran said its drones targeted Patriot systems and launchers at Ali Al Salem Air Base in retaliation for a US strike on a missile launch site on Qeshm Island. No damage or casualties were reported. Kuwait's Foreign Ministry condemned the attacks as a violation of its sovereignty and of UN Security Council Resolution 2817, affirming its right to self-defence under Article 51 of the Charter; Qatar, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, the GCC and the Arab League also condemned them.
Sources: Kuwait Times (KUNA) https://kuwaittimes.com/article/53958/kuwait/kuwait-repels-iran-drone-attack/ · Al Jazeera (AP) https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/18/kuwait-bahrain-face-new-iran-attacks-after-us-strike-on-qeshm-island · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/usisrael-iran-war-what-uae-residents-need-to-know-today-nov-19-2026-1.500752902

item.title: The UK Maritime Trade Operations agency (UKMTO) said an unknown projectile struck a tanker's engine room during an outbound transit of the …
item.description:
The UK Maritime Trade Operations agency (UKMTO) said an unknown projectile struck a tanker's engine room during an outbound transit of the Strait of Hormuz about 6 nautical miles north of Oman's Khasab at 16:45 GMT on Wednesday, and that all crew were safe; the tanker, the source of the projectile and the extent of damage or environmental impact were not identified. The agency urged vessels in the area to exercise heightened caution and report suspicious activity.

item.description:
Most Gulf bourses closed the week lower after a wave of regional attacks and Fed minutes that lifted the odds of a December rate hike to about 90%. The Saudi index fell 41.26 points (0.40%) to 10,158.90 on turnover of about SAR2.9 billion, weighed by a 1.5% drop in Saudi National Bank, while Aramco rose 0.2%. Kuwait's Premier Market index lost 0.59% to 8,956.33 and the all-share index 0.70% to 8,499.43, while Bahrain added 0.3%, Abu Dhabi was flat and Dubai eased 0.2% as Emirates NBD fell 1.6%.

item.title: The 49th Kuwait International Book Fair opened on Wednesday evening at the Sheikh Jaber Al-Ahmad Cultural Centre with Qatar as guest of hon…
item.description:
The 49th Kuwait International Book Fair opened on Wednesday evening at the Sheikh Jaber Al-Ahmad Cultural Centre with Qatar as guest of honour, featuring more than 592 local, Arab and international publishers from over 34 countries, and runs until 28 November. Omar Al-Omar, Minister of State for Communications and IT and Acting Minister of Information and Culture, opened it on behalf of the Prime Minister, in the presence of Qatar's Minister of Culture Sheikh Abdulrahman bin Hamad Al Thani; Al-Omar said culture is "a fundamental pillar of building a modern state, not an intellectual luxury", and writer Dr Khalifa Al-Waqayan was honoured as the fair's personality.

item.title: The IMF and Egypt reached a staff-level agreement on the eighth and final review of the Extended Fund Facility and the third review of the …
item.description:
The IMF and Egypt reached a staff-level agreement on the eighth and final review of the Extended Fund Facility and the third review of the Resilience and Sustainability Facility, unlocking about $2.3 billion subject to Executive Board approval: $1.5 billion under the EFF and up to $800 million under the RSF, bringing total disbursements to about $9.6 billion before both arrangements expire on 15 December. The Fund said real growth reached 5.1% in FY2025/26 and inflation was better than expected, while high debt and financing needs remain key vulnerabilities; Egypt has committed to a primary surplus of 5% of GDP in 2026/27 and about $1.5 billion in divestments, at least half earmarked for debt reduction.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/economy/2026/11/19/imf-reaches-final-deal-with-egypt-as-loan-programme-nears-end/ · Arab News https://www.arabnews.com/business/imf-reaches-23bn-staff-level-agreement-with-egypt-on-final-loan-reviews-3012882 · Youlyou https://www.youlyou.com/98283

item.title: President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi and Libyan Government of National Unity head Abdulhamid Dbeibah witnessed in Cairo the signing of nine agree…
item.description:
President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi and Libyan Government of National Unity head Abdulhamid Dbeibah witnessed in Cairo the signing of nine agreements and memoranda, attended by Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly. They include two framework agreements to develop natural gas infrastructure and refine petroleum products and a memorandum on energy and natural resources signed by Petroleum Minister Karim Badawi and his Libyan counterpart Khalifa Rajab Al-Sadiq, alongside memoranda on fisheries, scientific research, labour, training, small enterprises and media. Sisi affirmed support for Libya's security and unity and directed positive steps on visas, residency and the situation of Libyan students.

item.title: Finance Minister Ahmed Kouchouk told Greek bank leaders at the first Egyptian–Greek Economic Diplomacy Forum in Athens that net internation…
item.description:
Finance Minister Ahmed Kouchouk told Greek bank leaders at the first Egyptian–Greek Economic Diplomacy Forum in Athens that net international reserves rose to $57.5 billion at the end of October 2026, a tenth consecutive increase, that remittances from Egyptians abroad rose 29.6% to $47.3 billion, and that credit to the private sector reached EGP 3.7 trillion in July 2026 versus EGP 3 trillion in June 2025. He unveiled a $3 billion international issuance plan to diversify funding sources and urged Greek banks to play a bigger role in financing corporate expansion.

item.title: Egypt's under-17 team lost 2-1 to Greece in the first round of the U-17 World Cup in Qatar. After a goalless first half, Konstantinos Soufl…
item.description:
Egypt's under-17 team lost 2-1 to Greece in the first round of the U-17 World Cup in Qatar. After a goalless first half, Konstantinos Souflatzis scored Greece's opener in the 54th minute and Konstantinos Karangelis the second in the 62nd, before Ziad Saoudi pulled one back in the 71st, with Egypt finishing with ten men after Daniel Tamer was sent off. Coach Hussein Abdel Latif's side faces Qatar on Sunday 22 November and Panama on Wednesday 25 November.
Sources: Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7187115 · Youlyou https://www.youlyou.com/98410 · Khaligyoun https://www.khaligyoun.com/731002/

item.title: US stocks fell sharply on Thursday despite Anthropic's strong debut. Around 15:33 New York time (23:33 Doha time) the Dow was down 1,030.31…
item.description:
US stocks fell sharply on Thursday despite Anthropic's strong debut. Around 15:33 New York time (23:33 Doha time) the Dow was down 1,030.31 points (2.05%) at 49,167.86, the S&P 500 down 1.90% at 7,184.20, heading for a sixth straight loss, and the Nasdaq Composite down 2.16% at 23,903.23, after gains of more than 1% early in the session. Selling was driven by worries over stretched AI valuations, the abrupt exit of Jensen Huang as Nvidia's chief executive according to Reuters and AP, a roughly 9% drop in AMD after Hunterbrook disclosed a short position, and hawkish Fed minutes. The VIX volatility index jumped 13.27% to 27.83.

item.title: Oil prices rose on Thursday, with Brent up 1% at $92.88 a barrel and US crude up 1.6% at $83.59 during the New York session, after Brent se…
item.description:
Oil prices rose on Thursday, with Brent up 1% at $92.88 a barrel and US crude up 1.6% at $83.59 during the New York session, after Brent settled 1.28% lower at $91.95 on Wednesday. Prices are balancing Middle East attacks on tankers and facilities against glut concerns: the US Energy Information Administration reported a 3.4 million-barrel crude build to 417.8 million barrels, and both benchmarks are on track for a roughly 20% loss in November as regional exports recover, while OPEC+ meets on 29 November to set 2027 output.

item.title: Indian authorities evacuated nearly 100,000 residents of Odisha to safe shelters ahead of Cyclone Akvan, expected to make landfall on Frida…
item.description:
Indian authorities evacuated nearly 100,000 residents of Odisha to safe shelters ahead of Cyclone Akvan, expected to make landfall on Friday 20 November between Nellore and Tuni in Andhra Pradesh with winds of up to 130 km/h gusting to 145 km/h, the third severe cyclone to hit the east coast within a month. About 74 rescue teams were deployed, and East Coast Railway cancelled about 40 trains over three days.
Sources: The Peninsula (Xinhua) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/19/11/2026/india-evacuates-nearly-100000-ahead-of-cyclone-akvan · Oneindia https://www.oneindia.com/india/cyclone-akvan-andhra-pradesh-braces-for-145-kmph-winds-landfall-expected-on-november-20-8261885.html · The Siasat Daily https://www.siasat.com/andhra-braces-for-third-cyclone-in-three-weeks-as-akvan-brews-3578415/

item.title: US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin concluded their first trilateral meeting in Sh…
item.description:
US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin concluded their first trilateral meeting in Shenzhen on the sidelines of APEC, which lasted about an hour and a half at the Kylin Villa residence, with no oral statements afterwards. The Kremlin and Xinhua published a four-point "Declaration on Peace": making the UN more effective in maintaining peace, increasing production and supply of refined petroleum products to keep energy flows stable, respecting the immunities of government officials and preventing the ICC from abusing its jurisdiction, and dialogue to reduce nuclear risks because "a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought". The declaration made no mention of Ukraine or the war with Iran, although Trump said before the meeting that Washington and Beijing want to help end the Russia–Ukraine war.
Sources: Kyiv Post (Xinhua) https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90605 · TASS https://tass.com/politics/2221433 · Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/19/us-and-china-want-to-help-end-ukraine-war-trump-says-ahead-of-trilateral-with-russia · ABC News (Australia) https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-19/trump-xi-putin-meeting-live-blog-apec-summit/107394202

item.title: FIFA unveiled its presidential candidates, with incumbent Gianni Infantino, who has led FIFA since 2016 and seeks a fourth term, facing Fra…
item.description:
FIFA unveiled its presidential candidates, with incumbent Gianni Infantino, who has led FIFA since 2016 and seeks a fourth term, facing France's Philippe Diallo, president of the French federation, backed by European associations, and Japan's Kozo Tashima of the Japanese federation. The election will be held at the 77th FIFA Congress in Rabat on 18 March 2027, and member associations will be told the admitted candidates no later than 18 February 2027.
Sources: Gulf Times (Reuters) https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738588/sport/fifa-unveils-presidential-candidates-as-diallo-tashima-challenge-infantino · The Irish News https://www.irishnews.com/sport/soccer/who-is-standing-in-the-fifa-presidential-election-and-can-anyone-topple-infantino-MUG2KISPMJGXVDNJDE7VNSABXA/
